name: Gill CC Woodworks INC
old_description: Gill CC Woodworks specializes in custom-designed handmade dining tables, bars, coffee tables, doors, and more. For 10 years, we have celebrated the spirit of each tree and brought nature’s beauty into homes and businesses. Each piece is composed of sustainably sourced logs sawn right on site by the maker, from tree to heirloom. Featuring mortise and tenon joinery, butterfly inlays, live edge, or traditional profiles, each piece is genuinely one of a kind.
about:
Gill CC Woodworks operates from a third-generation family farm in Gill, Massachusetts. The shop was founded by Sam French, who learned the craft from his father, Dick French, a master of 18th-century reproduction furniture. French developed his own voice in the tradition, establishing a practice that honors the full lifecycle of each tree.

The company produces custom-designed, handmade furniture including dining tables, bars, coffee tables, doors, benches, beds, desks, and conference tables. Each piece begins with sustainably harvested logs that are sawn on the farm's own sawmill, then acclimated in a dedicated room before being crafted using mortise-and-tenon joinery, butterfly inlays, and live-edge or traditional profiles. The facility encompasses a tree farm, a large lumber and slab inventory, and a multi-room shop complex.

Clients range from private homeowners to institutions and commercial venues. Past projects include furniture for architect Maya Lin, Smith College's Neilson Library, the PACE Art Gallery, Amherst College, the Mount Grace Land Trust, Dudley Town Brewery, and a custom door for musician Will Calhoun of Living Colour. The shop also works with architecture firms such as Bialosky Architects.

French emphasizes a commitment to land protection and preservation, describing sustainability as paramount. The operation aims to celebrate the spirit of each tree by carrying it from harvest through milling to finished heirloom, offering clients a tangible connection to the material's origin.

name: Global Bridge Pharmaceutical
old_description: Global Bridge Pharmaceutical is a pharmacist-led pharmaceutical distribution and consulting company committed to improving access to safe, affordable, and high-quality medicines. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, our core operations focus on supporting healthcare providers, pharmacies, hospitals, specialty practices, and public health organizations across the United States through compliant sourcing, supply chain support, and strategic pharmaceutical services.
about:
Global Bridge Pharmaceutical operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, as a pharmacist-led pharmaceutical distribution and consulting company. The firm is certified as a Minority Business Entity (MBE) and holds HUBZone certification, with registration in the System for Award Management (SAM). It was established by professionals with a combined 55 years of experience across healthcare, drug regulation, and supply chain management, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The company provides Rx procurement, pharmacovigilance and drug safety services, global and managed access programs, and export and donor initiatives. Its core services include strategic pharmaceutical sourcing, hospital supply chain support, drug shortage and emergency procurement, managed access and patient support programs, repurposing of excess pharmaceuticals, and global access and export solutions. The team leverages an agile network of licensed suppliers, wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, and industry partners to deliver compliant, cost-effective solutions.

Global Bridge serves hospitals and health systems, clinics and pharmacies, government agencies and non-governmental organizations, and pharmaceutical manufacturers seeking distribution and access partners. It also supports public health programs and charitable clinics, particularly in North Carolina and other states where it holds licenses.

The company differentiates itself through its pharmacist-led expertise, regulatory awareness (USFDA-registered and DSCSA-compliant), and social impact initiatives such as RxSecondHome™, which redirects excess and short-dated medicines to underserved populations. Its mission emphasizes collaboration with healthcare professionals to improve access to safe, affordable, and high-quality medicines worldwide.

name: Global Electronics
old_description: Global Electronics develops and supplies automotive emissions calibration and end of line testing products to Automotive OEM’s and suppliers. Some of the products are : Misfire Generator and Dual Channel O-2 Fault Simulator to validate conformance to emissions standards for fuel emissions. USD II Automatic Transmission Solenoid end of line test and development system, Radio Frequency Signal Tracking System ( RFID ) for manufacturing applications, Powertrain Simulator, and other advanced simulation and development applications. Company also provides manufacturing and engineering services on number of targeted applications such as : Supplier Project Tracking Applications to OEM’s.
about:
Global Electronics is based in New Baltimore, Michigan. The company operates from a post office box in the Detroit metropolitan area.

The firm develops and supplies automotive emissions calibration and end‑of‑line testing equipment. Its product line includes the Misfire Generator, Dual‑Channel O₂ Fault Simulator, USD II automatic transmission solenoid test system, a radio‑frequency identification (RFID) signal tracking system, and an engine powertrain simulator. In addition to hardware, Global Electronics provides manufacturing and engineering services such as PLC re‑engineering, prototyping, assembly, wire‑harness fabrication, circuit‑board production, and design‑support teams that can be configured for specific applications.

Customers are primarily automotive original‑equipment manufacturers and their tier‑one suppliers, along with broader transportation‑industry clients. The company also pursues work transitioning government‑developed technologies — such as situational‑awareness systems, artificial‑intelligence tools, geo‑fencing, virtual‑reality interfaces, and commercial‑vehicle powertrain electronics — into civilian markets.

Global Electronics says its differentiator is a project‑selection strategy that favors contracts which yield generic products reusable in other markets, allowing development costs to be amortized across multiple customers. It also emphasizes its experience with PLC migrations and its ability to assemble experienced engineering teams for varied delivery models.

name: Global Steering Systems
old_description: Global Steering Systems is the world’s leading manufacturer of steering components for automotive giants like Ford Motor Company, Jeep, Lucid Motors, and General Motors, to name a few. With a decades-long track record of excellence and production capabilities in North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe, GSS designs and manufactures “must-have” products for ensuring driver safety and satisfaction the world over—now and in the years ahead.
about:
Global Steering Systems is headquartered in Watertown, Connecticut. The company was founded more than four decades ago as an independent, privately held business and remains under private ownership.

The company reports a decades-long track record of excellence and production capabilities across North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe. It designs and manufactures steering components including column shafts, U-joints, center-mounted support bearings, and complex intermediate shafts for column-drive and rack-drive applications. A proprietary high-performance spline slider is produced in-house. Operations are supported by a full-service test lab that validates products at every manufacturing step and a full-service engineering group that handles design, analysis, risk assessment, prototyping, and validation testing. GSS operates facilities in Connecticut (headquarters, R&D, and manufacturing), Michigan (sales and support), Changshu, China (manufacturing, sales, and support), Opole, Poland (manufacturing, R&D, sales, and support), and Ponta Grossa, Brazil (sales and support).

GSS serves the automotive industry, supplying light- and heavy-duty vehicle platforms. Its customer base includes major OEMs such as Ford Motor Company, Jeep, Lucid Motors, and General Motors.

The company emphasizes rigorous testing at every production stage, cross-functional product development teams, and the ability to combine innovative designs with off-the-shelf components to respond quickly to market demand. It states that these capabilities set a new global standard for steering systems.

name: Global Textile Alliance, Inc.
old_description: is the one with the most textile experience within GTA USA. With fabric production and design knowledge since 1953, this originally Belgian weaving mill has expanded its know-how across the world to bring you upholstery and curtain fabrics that radiate craftsmanship.
about:
Global Textile Alliance, Inc. (GTA USA) was founded in 2001 in Reidsville, North Carolina, by principals who each brought two decades of textile and bedding industry experience. The company was established to serve the bedding and furniture markets from a global perspective, leveraging a heritage that traces back to a Belgian weaving mill with fabric production knowledge since 1953.

The Reidsville facility operates as a vertical mill, integrating warping, weaving, circular knitting, and finishing under one roof. In-house yarn extrusion produces ecological yarns, while fabric formation technology and a quality-control lab support the development of mattress, upholstery, and curtain fabrics. Design, development, and sales teams collaborate on site, using trend research to create unique constructions, patterns, and colorations for brands including GTA USA, Ter Molst, and Symphony Mills—all part of the Love Home Fabrics group.

GTA USA supplies the bedding and furniture industries, providing mattress ticking, headboard and border fabrics, and upholstery materials for residential and contract markets. Its customer base includes manufacturers seeking domestic capacity with the flexibility to adjust to changing requirements, backed by global sourcing capabilities that mirror the company's European and Indian sister operations.

The company emphasizes local production on a global scale, highlighting sustainability benefits and the ability to respond quickly to shifting demand. Its founding principle centered on combining global reach with the agility to tailor fabrics to specific customer needs, a model that continues to drive its operations today.

name: GlobalFoundries
old_description: GlobalFoundries operates the world's largest semiconductor fabrication plant in Malta, NY. Provides foundry manufacturing services for a variety of integrated circuits, serving customers in microelectronics, mobile, IoT and automotive markets.
about:
GlobalFoundries is headquartered in Malta, New York, and was founded in 2009 as a joint venture between Mubadala Investment Company and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) to address growing global demand for advanced semiconductors. The company's first major U.S. fabrication facility began construction in Malta in 2013, becoming a cornerstone of its advanced manufacturing strategy.

The company operates as a pure-play semiconductor foundry, providing wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, and test services for fabless chip designers and integrated device manufacturers. Its technology portfolio spans CMOS, FinFET, FDX™ FD-SOI, BCD, Power GaN, RF-SOI, SiGe, RF GaN, silicon photonics, and quantum-process platforms. Manufacturing sites include Malta (global headquarters), Burlington, Vermont (RF and GaN center of excellence), Dresden, Germany, Singapore, and Guangzhou, China, with a workforce of 5,000–9,999 employees.

GlobalFoundries serves aerospace and defense, automotive, data-center and communications infrastructure, home and industrial IoT, and smart mobile device markets. Customers include companies such as Marvell, which collaborates on high-performance SiGe technology for optical connectivity, and the firm has partnered with TSMC to establish a U.S.-based supply of silicon interposers for advanced CoWoS® packaging. The MIPS subsidiary provides processor IP and virtual platforms for software-to-silicon development.

The company emphasizes differentiation through deep co-innovation with customers, governments, and universities, combining R&D, IP, design, and manufacturing across a flexible global footprint. Its stated mission is to deliver trusted, essential chips that enable AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world, with a quality philosophy targeting zero excursions and zero defects.

name: Gold Path Solar
old_description: Gold Path Solar was founded after more than 20 years in the solar industry to give property owners a better way to go solar. Too many customers face confusing presentations, high-pressure sales tactics, disconnected contractors and poor communication. We built an employee-owned solar company around clear guidance, personalized system design and accountable service.
about:
Gold Path Solar is an employee-owned solar installation company based in Greenville, South Carolina. The business was established by solar industry veterans with more than 20 years of experience who sought to address common complaints about high-pressure sales, poor communication, and subpar installations. The founders structured the company around a dedicated Solar Advocate model to provide clear guidance and accountable service from consultation through activation.

The company designs and installs personalized residential and commercial solar photovoltaic systems, along with battery storage solutions. Its in-house teams manage the full project lifecycle: consultation and system design, site survey, permitting and utility interconnection, installation, and commissioning. Installations are performed by company employees rather than subcontractors, with the average residential project completed in a single day. Gold Path Solar serves homeowners, businesses, farms, and nonprofits across Ohio, Kentucky, and South Carolina.

Gold Path Solar works primarily with residential homeowners seeking to offset electricity costs and gain energy independence. It also serves commercial clients including businesses, agricultural operations, nonprofits, and commercial property owners who want greater control over long-term energy expenses and demand charges. The company tailors system sizing to each customer's usage profile, roof or site conditions, and local utility rate structures.

The company was created to differentiate from what its founders identified as the industry's top complaints: confusing sales presentations, high-pressure tactics, disconnected contractors, and poor communication. Its employee-owned structure aligns team incentives with long-term customer satisfaction. A single Solar Advocate remains the customer's point of contact throughout the project, and the company emphasizes transparent design, in-house installation, and post-activation support.

name: Golden Barrel Products Honey Brook
old_description: For over 40 years, Golden Barrel has provided quality baking products with families and businesses across the country. As a family-owned company based in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, we are proud to provide flavorful ingredients through our network of distributors nationwide.
about:
Golden Barrel traces its roots to 1934, when M. Simon Zook founded the Zook Molasses Company in Honey Brook, Pennsylvania, to supply local farmers with feeding molasses. The family-owned, woman-owned business expanded in 1980 when Zook's daughter Sally and her husband Larry Martin launched the Golden Barrel brand, adding cooking and baking supplies to the product line. Today the company operates two family-run facilities in Honey Brook and Leola, Pennsylvania.

The facilities produce a range of sweeteners and baking ingredients — molasses, syrups, sugars (dry and liquid), corn syrups, invert sugars, dextrose, cooking oils, baking mixes, and fondants. With rail-served capacity, Golden Barrel processes bulk sweeteners at scale, offering more than 200 custom liquid blends and over 45 retail-ready products. Operations include liquid and dry blending, warehousing, private labeling, and transportation, serving customers from retail bottles to bulk tanker loads.

The company serves baking, confectionery, snack, beverage, and food-service markets across the United States. Its customers include bakeries, food manufacturers, and distributors of all sizes, with products distributed nationwide through a network of wholesale and online channels.

Golden Barrel emphasizes its nearly 90-year heritage, family craftsmanship, and commitment to pure, natural ingredients. The business is certified by WBENC as a women's business enterprise and offers kosher-certified products, while maintaining community partnerships throughout Lancaster County.

name: Good Cable
old_description: GoodCable Inc. is the oldest continuous cable assembly operation serving the greater Colorado Springs area since 1991.
about:
Good Cable, operating as GoodCable Inc., has been based in Colorado Springs, Colorado since its founding in 1991. The company describes itself as the oldest continuous cable assembly operation in the greater Colorado Springs area.

The shop specializes in custom wire harness and cable assembly manufacturing, covering prototyping through low-to-mid-volume production runs. Work is tracked via individual work orders, and the company offers both turnkey and consignment assembly models. Capabilities extend to electro‑mechanical box‑build assembly, with partner relationships for printed circuit board fabrication. Every assembly undergoes electrical and hipot testing with documented results for opens and shorts.

Customers span medical device makers, signage manufacturers (gas‑station and interstate signs), aerospace and defense (including F‑14 bomb‑release harnesses), telecommunications, automotive and motorcycle accessories, theatrical lighting, industrial equipment, and audio/video and computer peripherals. Long‑term clients include Hewlett Packard, Ethicon Endo‑Surgery, Skyline Electric Signs, and Rockwell, alongside smaller prototype‑only customers.

Good Cable’s stated differentiator is a quality guarantee: if a customer is not satisfied with an assembly, the labor and repair are free. The workmanship manual references IPC, ANSI, UE, and CSA standards alongside customer specifications. The company emphasizes decades of staff experience and a “if it’s copper, we’ll build it” breadth of materials from PVC to Teflon.
